de: The Battle of Chesma between the Russian Empire and the Ottoman Empire begins, resulting in one of the worst naval defeats of the Ottomans since Lepanto.

dz: 塞拉斯蒂内五世教皇在尼古拉斯四世教皇两年前去世后当选.
